images.filename: A. Schwab Building, Beale Street, Memphis, TN (53700180086).jpg
images.caption: Built in 1876, this Italianate-style building has housed the A. Schwab Dry Goods Store since its construction.  The building features a red brick exterior, decorative patterned brickwork, two-over-two double-hung windows, and first floor shopfronts with large plate glass windows and recessed entrance doors.  The building is a contributing structure in the Beale Street Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places and designated a National Historic Landmark in 1966.
